test_mamba_basic_generation: test the mamba model by generating text with a prompt and max_new_tokens parameter
test_mamba_all_params: test the mamba model generation with all sampling parameters like temperature, top_p, and repetition_penalty
test_mamba_load: test the mamba model under load by generating multiple responses and verifying consistency
run_mamba_fixture: run the fused kernel mamba fixture to launch the state-spaces mamba-130m-hf model with one shard
review_mamba_health_check: review the mamba client health check fixture that waits up to 300 seconds for readiness
